create_renderer_cpp: create a RendererCpp instance with a given width and height to initialize the C++ based renderer
add_object_to_renderer: add a 3D object model to the renderer by providing an object ID and model file path
render_object_with_pose: render a 3D object with a given rotation, translation, and camera intrinsics to get RGB and depth images
remove_object_from_renderer: remove a previously added 3D object from the renderer by its object ID
set_light_cam_pos: set the camera-relative position of the light source and update lighting on the C++ renderer
